flawed_step: Step 2: Inferring that v has two consecutive neighbors on a Hamiltonian cycle of G-v, so that v can be inserted into that cycle, is unjustified. Connectedness guarantees only that v has a neighbor.
counterexample: The Petersen graph is connected and non-Hamiltonian, but deleting any vertex leaves a Hamiltonian cycle; it is hypohamiltonian.
assessment_summary: The hypothesis does not imply the conclusion. The Petersen graph satisfies all stated conventions and is a counterexample, so no proof can be completed.
